Requires 16 collective dispatches (2 per iteration × 8 iterations) but each operates on 1/P of the data, trading dispatch count for smaller per-dispatch payload and potential parallelism.

strategies.name: Pipelined Overlapped All-Reduce Waves
strategies.desc: Pre-launch multiple all-reduce operations with dependencies expressed through buffer staging, allowing network stack to pipeline transfers. Uses 8 all-reduces but structures computation to expose maximum overlap between consecutive operations. Same 8 dispatches as baseline but optimizes for hardware pipelining and reduced bubble time.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Level Aggregation
strategies.desc: Exploit multi-node topology by performing intra-node reductions (within each node's devices) followed by inter-node all-reduce, then broadcast back. For 224 ranks, group into node-local collectives first. Increases total dispatches to ~24 (3 levels × 8 iterations) but each operates on smaller participant sets with lower latency.

strategies.name: Block-Striped All-to-All with Local Aggregation
strategies.desc:
Use all-to-all to distribute each of 8 blocks to designated owner ranks, perform local mean-square computation, then all-to-all to scatter results back. Replaces 8 all-reduces with 16 all-to-all operations, trading collective type for potential bandwidth gains when block ownership enables better load distribution and reduces synchronization points.
